summary: Current UI planning warrants Project Creation, Project Overview, Review & Decisions, Build & Realization, Subsystems & Workstreams, Extensions & Agents, Verification & Audit. Keep project creation visible while intent remains tentative, keep review surfaces bounded and non-final, let build-oriented pages emerge only...

project_pages.title: Project Creation
project_pages.purpose: Capture and tighten project intent, seriousness, compromise posture, and the conditions required before stronger product claims.
project_pages.why_this_page_exists: Project expectations remain default-tentative and have not yet been explicitly operator-reviewed.

sections.title: Intent & Quality Bar
sections.purpose: Show target outcome type, quality bar, seriousness, and whether those defaults are still tentative.
sections.show_when: Project expectations exist and still need explicit confirmation or tightening.
sections.hide_when: Hide once intent is operator-reviewed and stable enough to stop driving operator intake.

sections.title: Claim Guardrails
sections.purpose: Make explicit what the project must not become and what must be true before any real-product claim.
sections.show_when: Product posture is still prototype-oriented or operator intent is not yet locked.
sections.hide_when: Hide when stronger intent and realism already make these guardrails internalized rather than intake-level.

sections.title: Cost Posture
sections.purpose: Make intended value posture, target product tier, intended budget posture, acceptable cost posture, and early economic mismatch visible before stronger product ambition hardens.
sections.show_when: Cost posture is still tentative, risky, or mismatched enough to shape early project definition.
sections.hide_when: Hide when cost posture is stable enough that intake-level cost realism would only duplicate steering.

project_pages.show_when: Expectations are still tentative or not operator-reviewed.
project_pages.hide_when: Hide when the intent surface has been explicitly confirmed and no longer needs intake-level visibility.
representation_risks: Do not present conservative defaults as if they were confirmed operator intent.
Do not let an exploratory prototype posture quietly masquerade as an economically sensible product direction.

project_pages.title: Project Overview
project_pages.purpose: Summarize current truth, trust posture, realism posture, and the main fronts that matter right now.
project_pages.why_this_page_exists: Every project needs one compact surface for current truth, blockers, realism posture, and what should not be over-read.

sections.title: Current Truth
sections.purpose: Show current truth summary and the highest-value unblocked next step without flattening review, held, and blocked lanes together.
sections.show_when: Execution resume is available.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if there is no usable execution resume surface.

sections.title: Reality / Realism
sections.purpose: Show the current realism band, why that band is honest, and the strongest risk against overclaiming.
sections.show_when: Realism review is meaningful enough to guide operator posture.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if realism review does not exist yet.

sections.title: Budget Tier Posture
sections.purpose: Show intended budget posture, current tier posture, upward pressure points, and mixed-tier compromises without pretending the project has exact pricing.
sections.show_when: Budget posture is materially shaping whether the current direction still fits the intended tier or needs a mixed compromise.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if no bounded budget-tier review exists yet.

sections.title: Direction Of Travel
sections.purpose: Show which hardware, runtime, interaction, and product-shaping directions are currently winning, which alternatives are weaker, and what could still change the path.
sections.show_when: The project has enough differentiated pressure that the current favored path should be explicit rather than inferred from scattered cards.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if there is not yet enough steering truth to distinguish favored direction from deferred alternatives.

sections.title: Ideas I’m Exploring
sections.purpose: Show bounded non-leading ideas ELI is incubating, why they are visible now, what budget tier they fit, and what could raise or kill them.
sections.show_when: There are live exploratory ideas worth inspecting without confusing them for current direction or reviewable decisions.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no bounded exploratory idea is materially differentiating itself from current direction, held lanes, or review fronts.

sections.title: Operator Proposals
sections.purpose: Show operator-injected ideas under bounded review, ELI interpretation, fit with current direction and budget tier, and what would raise or kill a proposal.
sections.show_when: Operator proposals are live under review or the proposal-intake lane exists and should remain inspectable.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if operator proposal intake has been intentionally disabled and there is no proposal review surface to show.

sections.title: Trust & Source Authority
sections.purpose: Show which source currently owns the truth for this page and what remains supporting context.
sections.show_when: More than one truth-bearing surface exists or authority needs explanation.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if there is no meaningful current-vs-supporting distinction to explain.

sections.title: Project Topology
sections.purpose: Show the broad project map, current focus, blockers, held fronts, reviewable fronts, and operator-input-needed nodes as one interconnected structure rather than disconnected cards.
sections.show_when: The project now has enough differentiated fronts that an interconnected overview is more honest than a disconnected card-only view.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if the project is too small or too flat for a topology layer to add legibility.

sections.title: Current Working Target
sections.purpose: Show the one current milestone target, why it is active now, what it could unlock, what blocks it, and when ELI should escalate instead of continuing.
sections.show_when: No explicit deadline exists and milestone, cost, or grounding posture is strong enough that execution must be bounded operationally.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if the project truly has no meaningful execution boundary to explain.

sections.title: Cost Viability
sections.purpose: Show whether the project still makes economic sense beyond a prototype path, including any pause, stop, or reframe signal.
sections.show_when: Cost posture is materially shaping whether stronger product ambition still makes sense.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if no cost viability judgment exists yet.

project_pages.show_when: Always show once the project has enough structure for steering and trust posture.
project_pages.hide_when: Do not hide while the project is active.
representation_risks: Do not flatten current truth and supporting context into one neat progress story.
Do not let prototype progress visually imply that the economics are becoming sensible by default.
Do not let the topology view replace source authority; it is a derived overview and must keep truth posture visible per node.
operator_actions_supported: see how the main project fronts connect
see what makes ELI continue, pause, stop, or escalate

project_pages.title: Review & Decisions
project_pages.purpose: Surface bounded review fronts, milestone gates, and provisional decision or draft surfaces that are honestly ready for human inspection.
project_pages.why_this_page_exists: The project currently has 2 active review front(s), 1 ready-for-review milestone(s), and 2 emitted draft artifact review row(s).

sections.title: Reviewable Now
sections.purpose: Show what is honestly reviewable now, including draft briefs or milestone gates, without implying approval.
sections.show_when: There is a live review front, ready-for-review milestone, or emitted review artifact.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no bounded review front is currently live.

sections.title: Milestone Gates
sections.purpose: Keep milestone gating visible so reviewability is tied to maturity conditions and blockers rather than optimism.
sections.show_when: Milestones have differentiated states such as ready_for_review, held, or not_yet_reviewable.
sections.hide_when: Hide when milestone logic is not yet meaningful enough to guide review.

sections.title: Decision & Draft Context
sections.purpose: Show pending decisions, emitted review drafts, and how they relate without treating either as final truth.
sections.show_when: Bounded decisions or provisional draft artifacts exist.
sections.hide_when: Hide when there is no live decision or draft-review context.

project_pages.show_when: Show when there is a live review front, ready milestone, pending decision, or emitted provisional draft.
project_pages.hide_when: Hide when review surfaces would be empty or purely historical.
representation_risks: Do not present provisional drafts or ready-for-review milestones as approved outcomes.
Do not assume emitted draft review implies a live pending decision still exists.

project_pages.title: Build & Realization
project_pages.purpose: Expose build-oriented readiness only when implementation maturity, milestone state, or component-package posture makes that surface honest.
project_pages.why_this_page_exists: Implementation package review is `ready_for_review`, component-package posture is `early_subsystem_bom_only`, parts-readiness posture is `package_direction_only`, and pricing posture is `package_level_directional_only...

sections.title: Implementation Package Gate
sections.purpose: Show whether implementation-package review is actually ready, held, or still blocked by missing evidence.
sections.show_when: Implementation package review has meaningful gating logic.
sections.hide_when: Hide when implementation-package gating is not yet meaningful enough to guide realization.

sections.title: Component Package Readiness
sections.purpose: Show when BOM or component-package structure is warranted and what level of package honesty is justified now.
sections.show_when: BOM readiness is not `not_warranted` or buildability pressure is now materially relevant.
sections.hide_when: Hide when component-package readiness is still too weak to justify a build page.

sections.title: Build Blockers
sections.purpose: Keep unresolved implementation constraints visible so realization posture does not turn into a fake shopping list.
sections.show_when: There are unresolved component, subsystem, or realism blockers that materially constrain buildability.
sections.hide_when: Hide when build-oriented blockers are not yet materially distinct from general project blockers.

sections.title: Parts Readiness
sections.purpose: Show whether current truth supports package-only suggestions, provisional component candidates, or a stronger shortlist yet.
sections.show_when: Package posture or parts-readiness state is meaningful enough that the operator should not have to guess whether part suggestions are actually ready yet.
sections.hide_when: Hide when build posture is too weak to justify any honest package or part suggestion.

sections.title: Pricing & Alternatives
sections.purpose: Compare current package suggestions against cheaper, simpler, or better-fit alternatives without pretending the project has procurement-grade certainty.
sections.show_when: Current package direction is meaningful enough that the operator should see whether cheaper or simpler alternatives are better than waiting silently.
sections.hide_when: Hide when build posture is too weak for any honest pricing-direction comparison.

sections.title: Exploratory Rendering Briefs
sections.purpose: Show bounded hardware-aware rendering briefs only as exploratory review aids for packaging, placement, and comparison.
sections.show_when: At least one hardware-aware rendering brief is warranted by current build-oriented prototype posture.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no exploratory rendering brief is currently warranted or when build posture is still too weak.

project_pages.show_when: Show when component-package readiness or implementation-package gating becomes materially meaningful.
project_pages.hide_when: Hide while build-oriented structure would still be speculative or purely conceptual.
representation_risks: Do not present early subsystem BOM posture as a final part list or settled package.
Do not let subsystem confidence read as part confidence when the state still only justifies package-level suggestions.
Do not let pricing alternatives read like vendor quotes or procurement-grade certainty when the state still only justifies directional comparison.

project_pages.title: Subsystems & Workstreams
project_pages.purpose: Expose subsystem status, grounding, trend context, and next focus when the project has meaningful subsystem structure.
project_pages.why_this_page_exists: Fresh scorecard truth currently exposes 7 subsystem lane(s), which is enough to justify a real subsystem page rather than burying everything inside a generic overview.

sections.title: Subsystem Cards
sections.purpose: Show per-subsystem status, grounding, next focus, and compact history.
sections.show_when: Fresh scorecard truth exposes meaningful subsystem structure.
sections.hide_when: Hide when subsystem structure is too thin or stale to guide operator attention.

sections.title: Grounding & Status Meaning
sections.purpose: Help the operator distinguish improving, stalled, weakly grounded, and held lanes without over-reading confidence.
sections.show_when: Subsystem cards would otherwise risk being read as vague progress indicators.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if subsystem cards are not present.

sections.title: Blocked & Held Context
sections.purpose: Keep blocked and held lanes legible so the operator can tell whether a subsystem is improving, stable, or simply waiting on new grounding.
sections.show_when: There are blocked or held lanes with meaningful release conditions.
sections.hide_when: Hide when subsystem lanes are neither blocked nor held in a meaningful way.

project_pages.show_when: Show when fresh scorecard truth exposes real subsystem structure.
project_pages.hide_when: Hide when subsystem structure is too thin or stale for a dedicated page.
representation_risks: Do not let confidence trend visually outrun categorical grounding or status.

project_pages.title: Extensions & Agents
project_pages.purpose: Show which subordinate extension capabilities are active, which are recommended but still waiting for explicit operator opt-in, and what operator action is actually needed now without pretending hidden execution exists.

sections.title: ELI Primary Posture
sections.purpose: Keep explicit that ELI remains the main interface, synthesizer, and judge while extensions stay subordinate instruments.
sections.show_when: Specialist architecture exists and the operator needs to understand its authority boundary.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if there is no specialist architecture to explain.

sections.title: Top-Level Required Actions
sections.purpose: Show the extension actions that are actually waiting on the operator, before longer capability detail.
sections.show_when: One or more extension capabilities are recommended now but still waiting for explicit operator opt-in.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no extension action is currently needed from the operator.

sections.title: Active Now
sections.purpose: Show only extension capabilities explicitly modeled as active for this project.
sections.show_when: At least one extension capability is explicitly active for this project.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no extension capability is currently active.

sections.title: Recommended Waiting For Opt-In
sections.purpose: Show which capabilities are materially justified now but are still inactive until the operator explicitly opts in.
sections.show_when: Current build, review, or realism pressure makes at least one extension materially useful, but no opt-in is recorded yet.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no extension is currently recommended and waiting for opt-in.

sections.title: Available But Not Requested
sections.purpose: Show capabilities that exist now but are not currently being requested or activated for this project.
sections.show_when: At least one extension capability is available without being recommended or active.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no available-but-not-requested capability would help explain current control posture.

sections.title: Deferred Or Not Yet Justified
sections.purpose: Make clear which capabilities should stay inactive because they are deferred, future-ready, or not yet justified by current project pressure.
sections.show_when: Some capability rows should remain deferred or not yet justified under current project posture.
sections.hide_when: Hide when every visible capability is either active, waiting for opt-in, or merely available.

project_pages.show_when: Show when extension capabilities are real enough that the operator needs a bounded control view for active, waiting, available, and deferred posture.
project_pages.hide_when: Hide when the project has no meaningful specialist architecture or extension fit to explain.
representation_risks: Do not present extensions as equal minds or as hidden autonomous execution.
Do not let recommended waiting for opt-in read as active deployment.
Do not let any extension row imply one-click enablement when backend execution is still not wired.

project_pages.title: Verification & Audit
project_pages.purpose: Help the operator verify which surfaces are current truth, what changed recently, and what the UI must not imply.
project_pages.why_this_page_exists: The project now has enough truth-bearing surfaces and recent transitions that verification can no longer be left implicit.

sections.title: Current-Truth Sources
sections.purpose: Show which canonical surfaces currently own the truth for major operator questions.
sections.show_when: More than one truth-bearing surface exists and source authority matters.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if the operator would gain nothing from source-level verification.

sections.title: Recent Transitions
sections.purpose: Show the recent state changes that materially affect what the operator is seeing now.
sections.show_when: Transitions are meaningful enough to explain current UI posture.
sections.hide_when: Hide when no recent transition materially changes interpretation.

sections.title: Representation Risks
sections.purpose: Make visible the UI meanings that are most likely to drift into over-reading if not explicitly constrained.
sections.show_when: There are known places where UI could imply more certainty or concreteness than the state supports.
sections.hide_when: Hide only if the UI currently carries no meaningful representation risk.

project_pages.show_when: Show when truth authority, transition explanation, or representation risk needs explicit operator visibility.
project_pages.hide_when: Hide when the project is too simple for verification surfaces to add meaning.
representation_risks: Do not turn verification into a raw developer log browser.
